evidence_class: The single repair round on e45c3cd1. Offline unit checks of the recipe with Docker mocked (our integration checks, not upstream tests), source reads at pinned upstream revisions, and an audit-hook run showing that the suite opened no file or sqlite store under the live OmniRoute data directories. No container or network was created and no gateway or model request was made. The G5 tests read synthetic sqlite stores only.
sanitization: The worktree prefix is shown as <worktree>, the scratch directory as <scratch>, the unit TMPDIR as <tmpdir> and the local OmniRoute source checkout as <omniroute-source>. The module prefix `tests.test_runtime_worker_openhands.` is dropped from test names. Red outputs are excerpts: the summary lines, each non-ok test with its count of non-ok lines (subtests) when above one, and each distinct first exception line with its count, cut at 220 characters. Tracebacks are omitted; rerunning a command on its tree reproduces them. Green outputs keep the summary lines. Full outputs stay private.

reviews.headless_claude: changes-needed on e45c3cd1: R1 blocker (grading on the default bridge), R2 medium (the probe refused its own server), R3 high (G5 unenforced), R4 low (P2 weak), R5 low (correlation unused in the receipt), R6 low (holds only in documents), C9 medium (the decision record overclaimed); eight confirms.
reviews.gpt6: changes-needed on e45c3cd1: containment-grader high (same as R1), session-key-logging low, probe-receipt-trust low, gw-8080 info, nginx-headers info; six confirms.

decisions: Coordinator repair round of 2026-09-28: new commits on e45c3cd1, a failing test first for every code item, and no push, rebase, manifests/evidence.json change, container, network or gateway request. R5 was not applied as written. At OmniRoute 045aa81f3 and dd6e9607e the recipe's /v1/responses path stores a gateway-generated correlation ID (entry 15), so passing correlation_ids={run_id} would drop every row. Entry 11 shows that change turning the fixture's usage into an empty window. Receipts keep time-window attribution and say why, and the P3 steps move the correlation check to a /v1/chat/completions call.

item_notes.R1: Grader containers are created with network mode none, the SDK create body is checked, and the created container's inspect must show only the network none; otherwise it is removed and not graded.
item_notes.R2_R4_addendum_b: After the red run one test changed: on this host a closed loopback UDP port times out rather than answering ECONNREFUSED, so the real-socket case accepts either and a mocked recv covers ECONNREFUSED.
item_notes.R6_probe_receipt_trust: After the red run one assertion changed: a per-file count of stage-gates mentions became a check that no recipe file writes, opens, replaces, renames or touches the stage-gates file.
item_notes.R3_G5: The red tree had no config/host.example.json change. Entries 09 and 13 show the suite touching no live store, and entry 14 shows the audit hook detecting planted live-store events.
item_notes.R5_gw8080_log: R5 is the source-checked deviation in `decisions`. The same commit rewords check_server_env's docstring (addendum a) and the P3 skeleton; wording has no red run.
